manager_rule: Workers propose next_goal; only the project manager reassigns work orders.

excluded_role.reason: Registered status-only fifteenth task; not enabled as an engineering or research worker.

work_orders.objective: Implement a fail-before-side-effects pre-dispatch conformance harness that binds the exact checkout, frozen authorities, executor, verifier, keys, capacity, and storage readiness.
acceptance: A wrong executor or source digest is rejected before any model or Docker process starts.
The report records exact module __file__, Git commit, authority digests, and test output.
No frozen scientific artifact is changed.
work_orders.next_goal: Integrate the conformance capability at the activation entry point after independent review.

work_orders.objective: Diagnose and repair the Kimina/Qwen executor-authority mismatch without signing, publishing, or activating production authority.
acceptance: One exact model, image, GGUF, tokenizer, runtime, build lock, launcher, and capacity identity is derived consistently in dry-run tests.
Stale Qwen/Kimina cross-binding is rejected deterministically.
No production signature, image publication, or activation occurs.
work_orders.next_goal: Prepare a reviewed, explicit reprovisioning input set for the chosen executor.

work_orders.objective: Eliminate stale-checkout Python import contamination and make test provenance an executable gate.
acceptance: Tests fail if supernova_goal1 imports outside the current checkout.
The current Git commit and module path are printed or captured in CI evidence.
A clean isolated environment runs the targeted suite.
work_orders.next_goal: Add the provenance gate to every release and authority-generation workflow.

work_orders.objective: Repair verifier teardown truthfulness so cleanup uncertainty can never produce a signed or stored mathematical verdict.
acceptance: Injected _remove_observed failure results in zero signer calls and zero evidence-store writes.
A separate host-incident path states teardown is unknown without claiming a verifier result.
Normal teardown behavior remains covered.
work_orders.next_goal: Extend the same no-sign invariant to Docker control-plane and persistence failures.

work_orders.objective: Specify the complete verifier terminal algebra and exact code/test seams for semantic INVALID versus heartbeat, timeout, OOM, internal, format, and host-incident outcomes.
acceptance: Every Lean/container/host failure maps to one typed state.
Heartbeat, timeout, OOM, and internal failures can never become INVALID.
The report names exact current symbols and deterministic negative tests.
work_orders.next_goal: Implement the reviewed algebra after MF04's teardown repair lands.

work_orders.objective: Audit expected-challenge/export digest binding and design a minimal fix that prevents checker mix-up or challenge substitution from producing VALID.
acceptance: The exact unchecked challenge_export_sha256 path is reproduced.
The proposed binding identifies the trusted expected digest and signing boundary.
Negative tests cover challenge, source, checker, run, and arm substitution.
work_orders.next_goal: Implement the binding after the teardown patch establishes the safe signing path.

work_orders.objective: Produce a Docker/process lifecycle hardening plan covering bounded control commands, monotonic timing, process-tree termination, output streaming, orphan detection, and restart recovery.
acceptance: Every Docker invocation and filesystem write has a timeout/failure state.
The plan records pre-kill, post-kill, and post-remove observations.
Tests cover daemon hang, output flood, disk full, clock rollback, and orphan containers.
work_orders.next_goal: Implement lifecycle supervision in a dedicated reviewed work order.

work_orders.objective: Enforce exact raw model-response bytes and close pilot-admission holes without running a model.
acceptance: Fenced, wrapped, prose, escaped-newline, or transcript output is FAILED_FORMAT without repair.
Candidate SHA equals the exact raw response SHA.
One VALID plus any model/verifier timeout cannot admit the smoke.
work_orders.next_goal: Bind provider/model invocation receipts to the immutable raw request and response.

work_orders.objective: Design the versioned benchmark-v2 compatibility authority for all 488 statements without runtime normalization or held-out model leakage.
acceptance: The gate tests every statement with only its proof body replaced by sorry under the exact release verifier identity.
Only proven incompatibilities are patched and rehashed.
Held-out output reveals compatibility status/digests but no theorem bytes to model developers.
work_orders.next_goal: Implement the compatibility gate after protocol v2 authorizes the independent held-out checker.

work_orders.objective: Design a finite-heartbeat calibration and a tested known-good proof for amc12a_2003_p1, explicitly discriminating the sum_range_succ expansion hypothesis.
acceptance: The proposal does not blindly adopt 500K heartbeats.
A finite preregistered diagnostic grid compares the observed tactic with a non-expanding proof shape.
The wall watchdog is a generous backstop and every resource outcome remains UNKNOWN.
work_orders.next_goal: Run the non-credit diagnostic only after the typed verifier and benchmark-v2 gates pass.

work_orders.objective: Implement the durable full-cohort scheduling skeleton that can advance beyond start-first, using synthetic model/verifier fixtures only.
acceptance: Next/lease/commit/recover semantics cover every synthetic slot.
Crash and concurrent restart tests preserve exactly-once scientific accounting.
No real model, held-out problem, activation nonce, or production verifier is used.
work_orders.next_goal: Connect the runner to reviewed authority and verifier capabilities after their gates pass.

work_orders.objective: Write the prospective validation-calibration and paired-power plan for ordinary, verified_chain, and product_only.
acceptance: The plan freezes seed, split, min/max size, sequential rule, exclusions, and viability bands before data.
It measures emission, admission, time-to-admission, later exposure, downstream lift, discordance, latency, and complete cost.
Final sample size follows paired calibration rather than assuming 60 or 19,520.
work_orders.next_goal: Convert the reviewed calibration result into a sealed, family-aware v2 power calculation.

work_orders.objective: Continuously review hourly-worker PRs for path scope, authority integrity, evidence quality, test provenance, and false-green gates; author reports only.
acceptance: Every review binds the exact PR head and commands/results inspected.
Self-reports are treated as untrusted until independently reproduced.
Unresolved critical findings block manager acceptance but do not mutate implementation.
work_orders.next_goal: Review the next highest-priority open worker PR or recheck an amended head.

work_orders.objective: Build a synthetic, non-credit adversarial integration suite spanning conformance, verifier, persistence, lifecycle, and cohort-recovery boundaries.
acceptance: Fixtures exercise wrong authority, teardown failure, resource UNKNOWN, raw-format rejection, crash recovery, replay, and storage failure.
No real model, held-out theorem, production key, or activation nonce is used.
The report distinguishes tested behavior from missing seams.
work_orders.next_goal: Run the full synthetic schedule after the first reviewed component integrations land.
